about.title: About Hope E Hartman, CPA
text: Hope Hartman earned her bachelor's in accounting, with a minor in oil and gas accounting, and then a master's in accountancy and taxation, both at the University of Houston.

She has over 17 years of experience in the public and private sectors, including more than 14 years in oil and gas accounting. She has also worked with new start-ups and has experience closing down companies.
Our mission is simple: your success is our success, helping the community one client at a time.
